title: Docs: patch signing with patatt/b4 across all guides and the runbook
description:
Add patatt/b4 everywhere it belongs, once the fork (mzkw.7) and b4 check (mzkw.8) exist so every command can be run:
- guide-regulars: install the patatt fork (pip install from github.com/MarkAtwood/patatt branch git-vouch, or the b4 that bundles it); configure signing with your registry SSH key (patatt.signingkey, patatt.selector = the selector 'git vouch status' prints); b4 send / git send-email hook signs; what recipients see.
- guide-captains: the same, plus checking incoming patches with b4 am (pass / warned legacy-GPG pass / fail / no key), and what to tell a contributor whose patch is unverified.
- guide-anchors: the same, plus kernel-wide config guidance and the decision to drop the GPG fallback at the late cutoff.
- All three, 'Flag day': keyringsrc = vouch: first, legacy GPG keyring second (warned fallback for everyone until the late cutoff). 'Rotating your key': the selector changes with the key, so update patatt.selector. 'If you lose a key': revoked keys stop verifying patches immediately after sync.
- docs/flag-day.md: the patatt timeline (install fork before flag day; remove the legacy keyringsrc line after the late cutoff).
- docs/vouching.md: one line that an endorsed email is what makes your patches verify.
acceptance_criteria: Every patatt/b4 command shown is run in a throwaway setup with the real fork and real b4 (doc test); behaviour matches DESIGN.md 'Patch signing'.
notes:
Also cover patatt raw 'ed25519' keytype users (patatt genkey): they may have no GPG key in pgpkeys, the vouch: source skips non-openssh keytypes, and after the late cutoff their patches stop verifying. Tell them to register an SSH key and switch patatt to openssh signing.
Before publishing the install line (pip install 'patatt @ git+https://github.com/MarkAtwood/patatt@git-vouch'): the fork's git-vouch branch must be pushed with Mark's approval. As of 2026-10-22 origin/git-vouch lacks 2e80bef 'feat: add vouch: keyring source', so that install line gives a patatt with no vouch: source and keyringsrc = vouch: finds no keys silently. Also: b4.attestation-recheck-hours exists only in the unsent vouch-mzkw.9 b4 commits; do not document it as released b4 config.
